pk.context: 1500 mg intravenous, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: clear, colorless solution in a single-use vial

clues.kinetics: Almost completely absorbed after oral dosing, and the injection is bioequivalent to tablets. Under 10% bound to plasma protein, and 66% of the dose is excreted unchanged by the kidneys.
clues.substance: A single enantiomer, crystalline powder with a molecular weight of 170.21 that is very soluble in water.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA as 500 mg per 5 mL single-use vials that must be diluted before intravenous infusion.
clues.safety: Contraindicated with known hypersensitivity, as anaphylaxis and angioedema have occurred; no boxed warning. Somnolence and asthenia are the most common reactions.
clues.indication: Partial-onset seizures from 1 month of age; adjunctive therapy for myoclonic seizures in juvenile myoclonic epilepsy and for primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures; intravenous when oral dosing is not feasible.
clues.mechanism: Binds the synaptic vesicle protein SV2A, thought to regulate vesicle exocytosis; the precise antiepileptic mechanism is unknown.

tell: Chemically unrelated to existing antiepileptic drugs, it binds the synaptic vesicle protein SV2A.

is a white to off-white crystalline powder

clues.product: KEPPRA injection must be diluted prior to intravenous infusion
clues.safety: KEPPRA is contraindicated in patients with a hypersensitivity to levetiracetam
Reactions have included anaphylaxis and angioedema
the most common adverse reactions in adult patients receiving KEPPRA in combination with other AEDs, for events with rates greater than placebo, were somnolence, asthenia
clues.indication: KEPPRA is indicated for the treatment of partial-onset seizures in patients 1 month of age and older
Myoclonic seizures in patients 12 years of age and older with juvenile myoclonic epilepsy
Primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures in patients 6 years of age and older
KEPPRA injection is for intravenous use only as an alternative for patients when oral administration is temporarily not feasible
clues.mechanism: Experimental data indicate that this binding site is the synaptic vesicle protein SV2A, thought to be involved in the regulation of vesicle exocytosis
The precise mechanism(s) by which levetiracetam exerts its antiepileptic effect is unknown
